channel.title: The Switch Stack
channel.description: Where the numbers flip the narrative. Environmental intelligence, biweekly.

item.title: Carbon, Methane, and Nanoplastics: Why Your Household Footprint Doesn't Stand a Chance
item.description: Ukraine and Gaza are the first wars in human history with real-time environmental tracking. The CEO of Europe's largest missile maker boasts about "doubling production without compromising sustainability." Meanwhile, 200 US cargo flights to Israel emitted more CO₂ than the entire nation of Grenada does in a year.

item.title: How to Conduct a Genocide, Sustainably
item.description: Oct 7 killed 1,200 people at 0.03 tonnes of CO₂ per death. Israel's operation in Gaza: 4 tonnes per kill, 81% of structures destroyed, up to 61 Mt long-term CO₂ — and an arms industry that files ESG reports about it.

item.title: Precision Warfare, ESG Compliant: The Numbers Behind the Narrative
item.description: In Gaza's first 60 days, Israel and its US supply chain produced over 99% of all war emissions. 81% of structures destroyed. Up to 61 Mt CO₂. Hamas rockets: 713 tonnes of CO₂ for nothing.

item.title: Future's Breadbasket, Rich on Heavy Metals
item.description: Nanoplastics from pulverized drone casings. Lead, cadmium, and mercury from 26,000 detonated shells — all saturating Ukraine's soil, Europe's most fertile farmland. 100 to 300 years to clean naturally.
